QuestInfo.name: I'm Bored!
QuestInfo.0: People in Kampung Village seem less perky and more irritable than they used to be. Talk to #b#p9270061##k and see what else he needs to bring the energy back to village.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9270061##k and the rest of the village are bored. Hunt #b#o9420528#s#k and collect #b#t4000466#s#k so they can entertain themselves with their favorite songs.
QuestInfo.2: Kampung Village is now full of delightful melodies, played on the finest #b#t4000466#s#k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Exp 100,000\nAble to proceed to the 'All Taken Away!' quest.\n

0.0: Kampung Village is the most wonderful place in the world, minus the heat and the... boredom. Honestly, there's nothing to do here except talk to each other.
0.1: Recently, we've started to get on each others' nerves. As chief, I feel responsible for keeping the village entertained. Obviously, I can't leave my post here, but you... you can bring music and laughter to us!

yes.0: Beat #b50 #o9420528#s#k and bring me #b50 #t4000466#s#k, and the village will come to life with music!

no.0: Life without music isn't worth living!

1.0: Ah, a #b#t4000466##k is a fine instrument, don't you think?

yes.0: Stick around, and enjoy the traditional melodies of Kampung!

item.0: You need to beat #b50 #o9420528#s#k and bring me #b50 #t4000466#s#k! We will all perish from boredom!
